question_stem: It is known that 20% of male giant pandas in a certain area weigh more than 121 kg and 71.9% weigh more than 102 kg. Weights of male giant pandas in this area have a normal distribution. Find the mean and standard deviation of the weights of male giant pandas in this area.

parts.question_text: It is known that 20% of male giant pandas in a certain area weigh more than 121 kg and 71.9% weigh more than 102 kg. Weights of male giant pandas in this area have a normal distribution. Find the mean and standard deviation of the weights of male giant pandas in this area.
